blurb: This check inspects the inetd configuration for remote-access services that transmit passwords and session data as readable plain text, such as telnet, ftp, and the r-commands like rlogin and rsh. When one of these services is enabled, credentials and everything typed in a session travel across the network in a form anyone watching the wire can read. If they stay on, an attacker who can see that traffic can capture the credentials and use them to take over accounts.
